title: How to WP product.json
description: Store-facing product copy that lives at the root of a How to WP product repository (not inside the plugin zip folder). howtowp-core later syncs this file from a GitHub Release asset onto the howtowp.ir product page. Every customer-facing text field is bilingual: an object with required 'fa' and 'en' strings. Do not put version, changelog, Requires at least, Requires PHP, Tested up to, or the zip filename here — those come from the plugin header, readme.txt, CHANGELOG.md and the GitHub Release. Do not put price, club membership, or other store-only editorial policy here.

$schema.description: Must point at this canonical schema URL.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Bump only when the schema itself changes.

catalog_slug.description: Stable public catalog slug, e.g. woo-sync. Set once; do not rename without a migration plan.

wc_slug.description: WooCommerce product post slug on howtowp.ir, e.g. woo-sync-plugin. May differ from catalog_slug.

code_repo.description: GitHub owner/repo in lowercase, e.g. howtowp/woo-sync.

type.description: Product type. Optional; defaults to plugin.

name.description: Short product name (e.g. ووسینک / WooSync), not the long WooCommerce H1 and not the SEO title.

store_title.description: Optional longer title for the store H1 if it should differ from name.

short_description.description: Short paragraph for the hero excerpt and schema description. Plain text, no HTML.

features.description: Key feature cards for the امکانات tab. Only features that exist in the code. Keep each item's id stable across edits.

use_cases.description: Problem / solution pairs for the کاربرد و راه‌کار tab. Keep each item's id stable.

faq.description: Seed questions and answers for the product FAQ. Keep each item's id stable. User-generated Q&A on the site is separate.

audience.description: Who the product is for: store owners / regular users, and vibe coders who will extend it.

demo_url.description: Public live demo URL, or null when there is none.

video_url.description: Intro / demo video URL (YouTube, Vimeo, or MP4), or null when there is none.

product_page.description: Optional canonical store product URL, e.g. https://howtowp.ir/product/woo-sync-plugin/.

requirements_notes.description: Extra requirement notes that are not already in the plugin header or readme.txt (for example 'WooCommerce must be active on every connected site'). Do not repeat Requires at least / Requires PHP / Tested up to.

ai_guide.description: Path to the customer AI-GUIDE.md, relative to the repository root. In the project layout this is '<plugin_dir>/AI-GUIDE.md' so the file ships inside the zip. Do not point at AGENTS.md.

fa.description: Persian (Farsi) text. Use Persian yeh/keh. Plain text, no HTML.

en.description: English text. Plain text, no HTML.

stable_id.description: Stable kebab-case id. Once published, do not rename it; add a new item instead.

icon.description: Icon hint for the theme (a Material Symbols / Dashicons-style name such as sync, tune, or inventory_2). Not a file path.

regular_users.description: Bullets for store owners and everyday users.

vibe_coders.description: Bullets for developers and vibe coders who will extend the product with Cursor or a companion plugin.
